title: 3D Gaussian Splatting via XGF — Load, Export to XGF, Re-Import
description: End-to-end check that xeokit's native XGF format can round-trip a Gaussian-splat SceneModel. Loads a captured interior from .splat, exports it to binary XGF with XGFExporter (which auto-selects XGF v3 — the first version with per-splat scale + rotation buffers — because the model contains GaussianSplatsPrimitive geometry), then re-imports the XGF bytes with XGFLoader into the displayed SceneModel. Scales survive exactly and rotations to within 8-bit, so the re-imported scene renders like the original. Demonstrates persisting mixed CAD + reality-capture scenes as a single native asset. Browser only.
